items.title: Hal Galper interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 27, 2022
items.q: “Changing With the Times” — Margie — who was it, Chuck Wayne, Margie Hyams, that band.

ctx.x: Well we collect things you know, and we have some George Shearing things. I’m just making a joke really. But that’s a great story. And a key of E. You can play jazz for years and never play a song in the key of E.

Exactly. But he was such a trained pianist you know, he just had, he was a master on the piano and he could do whatever he wanted you know. And then just recently my old lady who has opened up a vintage vinyl store found that record. I have it up now framed next to my piano, the record that got me started, “Changing With the Times” — Margie — who was it, Chuck Wayne, Margie Hyams, that band.
Yeah. Oh that’s a great circle of life sort of story.
